versions.subject: Add sysmon_cmstp_execution
versions.detection:
# CMSTP Spawning Child Process
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage: '*\cmstp.exe'
# Registry Object Add
selection2:
    EventID: 12
    TargetObject: '*\cmmgr32.exe*'
# Registry Object Value Set
selection3:
    EventID: 13
    TargetObject: '*\cmmgr32.exe*'
# Process Access Call Trace
selection4:
    EventID: 10
    CallTrace: '*cmlua.dll*'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: (EventID=1 ParentImage="*\\cmstp.exe") OR (EventID=12 TargetObject="*\\cmmgr32.exe*") OR (EventID=13 TargetObject="*\\cmmgr32.exe*") OR (EventID=10 CallTrace="*cmlua.dll*")
